known.title: C1 puts the rule to apply the text before the change inside the reviewer files that a diff can change, and the Codex wrapper loads the project-local reviewer first, so a diff that changes the reviewer files sets the rules of its own review
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 1, C1 (line 37); Steps, row 3 candidates, Files (line 62); Steps, row 6 ship, Files (line 65)
known.summary: C1 tells the code reviewer to apply the text before the change when a diff changes an instruction file, the plan contract, or the reviewer's own files. This rule is in the reviewer files that it must protect. At repo_ref, .codex/agents/code-reviewer.toml (lines 7-9) loads plugins/plan-lifecycle/agents/code-reviewer.md and uses the project-local copy when it is present, and code-reviewer.md (lines 10-12) loads its skill from the same plugin folder. A diff that replaces these files removes the rule before the review starts, because the runtime has already loaded the changed text. No step changes the wrappers or their templates, and no Files cell names them. The plan must select trusted instructions outside the reviewed input (the installed plugin) in the reviewer bootstrap, and name the wrapper files in a step.

known.title: C1 lets the code reviewer report a rule violation that a recorded decision makes, but the unchanged judge rubric rates such a finding wrong because the plan records the behavior, so decision 5 counts a correct C1 finding against C1
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 1, C1 (line 37); Research, Decisions, decision 5 (line 42); Steps, row 1 harness_arms, Files (line 60); Steps, row 5 heldout_runs (line 64)
known.summary: C1 ranks the instruction files and the plan contract above recorded decisions, so a C1 reviewer reports an intended change that breaks a repository rule. At repo_ref, .agents/skills/review-benchmark/references/judge.md line 33 rates a finding without a match `wrong` when 'the plan records the behavior as intended'. score.mjs (lines 719-722) adds each `wrong` rating to the wrong findings of the run, and decision 5 allows the candidate at most 0.10 more wrong findings per run than main. So the judge rates a correct C1 Standards finding as wrong, and the bound can reject the change that the plan wants to measure. No step changes judge.md before the deciding runs (harness_arms names only prepare.mjs, SKILL.md, the test, and test-contracts.json).

protected.summary: Yolo decision: this plan does not test a second model family, the external-behavior check (D2), a coverage verdict for unread hunks, web search for the code reviewer, numeric confidence scores, finding caps, or majority votes.

Yolo decision: the dev check runs main and P1 on 6 dev plan cases with 2 runs, and B3 and C3 on 4 dev code cases with 1 run; each candidate may be revised once from the dev check, without held-out data.
Yolo decision: this plan makes no release; plan-lifecycle is released after the merge only with its own question.
